item.text: The notes distinguish three main readings of “left suda”: neglect of duties in life, lack of reckoning or requital, and remaining in the grave without resurrection. Some sources explicitly combine them. I’m keeping those distinctions visible while placing the lexical examples and evidence with the positions they support.
